summary: Two-week window (Sep 25 to Oct 9; the Oct 2 run died before publishing). It splits in two. First half, churn watch: ten days of total silence (Sep 18 to Sep 28), then two 'Done:)' replies and the Sep 15-30 invoice paid in 3h04m with no questions. Second half, partial re-engagement. On Oct 2 Melissa posted the first written proof of where Callie's content goes (one reel, a list of 23 repost-network accounts, live Oct 5). Callie answered with her longest message since Sep 15: she questioned the video choice and offered new content from her month in America. Melissa answered in writing ('highest engagement on your page'), not with a call offer, and Callie thanked her. Mica took over the empty promo lane, asked for reels on Oct 3, and Callie uploaded within 86 minutes. Client asks went 0 -> 0 -> 1. That is small, but it is the first rise since Sep 18. Nothing structural moved on ALTR's side. Five invoice cycles still have no written receipt confirmation; the last one was Jul 23 (78 days). Stephski's Oct 2 'Thank you queen 🙏' acknowledges the 'Done:)' but does not confirm receipt, and the Oct 1 payment passed its Oct 8 due date unconfirmed. The main Instagram account has been open 108 days. Derrek's Aug 1 rollout promise is 69 days overdue and he has not posted in 23 days; the owner-silent churn signal fires Oct 16. Vivek has never posted. Mayson's accepted call is 32 days unbooked; his only message this window was a one-word 'Yeah' in the Promo topic. Nobody took up Callie's offer of new America content. The Oct 15 invoice is next, and the reconciliation message should go out first.

health.rationale: Up 6 from 36, the score the unpublished Oct 2 run gave the first half of this window. Still 2 below the last published score (44, Sep 18), so this is a partial recovery, not a turnaround. Trajectory: 82 -> 74 -> 66 -> 54 -> 50 -> 42 -> 44 -> (no Sep 25 report, silent week) -> 36 unpublished -> 42. Why up: of the four churn signals, only one is clearly firing now. (1) Owner silent 30+ days: not yet. Derrek last posted Sep 16 (23 days), so it fires Oct 16. (2) Results question answered with a call offer: the opposite happened. Callie's Oct 2 challenge on the repost choice got a written, results-based answer ('highest engagement on your page'), and she replied 'Okay great thank you:)'. (3) Long-promised deliverable with no written proof: FIRING. Derrek's phone-farm/IG rollout updates (Aug 1) are 69 days overdue and the main IG account is 108 days open. The 23-account repost list is the first written proof of any distribution and partly offsets this. (4) Most ALTR messages billing: not firing. Billing was 3 of 12 ALTR messages (Stephski), down from 2 of 4 at the Oct 2 midpoint and 6 of 11 on Sep 18. Client asks by window: Sep 18: 1 (payee question) -> Sep 25: 0 (silent) -> Oct 2 midpoint: 0 -> Oct 9: 1 (the repost-choice question, plus a minor 'should be good until I do that?'). Client messages were 5 across 14 days: 2 terse 'Done:)' replies in the first half, then 3 engaged ones. She also volunteered new content unprompted, which is the opposite of a client winding down. Why only 42: the fast, silent payment (3h04m, zero questions, Oct 1) is still a churn tell. Five unconfirmed payment cycles are 2-9 weeks old. Every owner-level and Meta-support promise is unmet. Promo ownership changed (Michelle 53 days silent, Mica stepping in) without anyone telling her. And her offer of new content got no direct response.
